content.comment_body: Hello everyone, I'm working on linking one [product_name] module with another, but I'm not sure how to proceed. Both modules have their own independent programs. I want to use an analog input from one module to control something in the other. Any advice is appreciated. Thanks, [user_name]
You need to set up a connection between the two [product_name] modules and use the Parameter-VM-Mapping feature.
Thanks, [user_name], it works now, though I don't fully understand it yet. Is there a guide available for this process? Thank you, [user_name]

The issue is with [article_no]. It can only send network outputs (digital or analog) to a [article_no] slave [product_name] module. That's why it's not possible to link the diagrams of two different versions via drag & drop. If you'd like, I can make a screen recording to demonstrate.
Hi [user_name], I don't want to impose, but if you have time, please make the video tomorrow. Thank you, [user_name]

You're not imposing at all! Otherwise, I wouldn't offer to help. For modules since [article_no], there's a special VM memory area for data exchange. Parameter-VM-Mapping lets you transfer blocks of digital or analog data into this area, which is then sent from the transmitting [product_name] to the receiving one. You need to set up the addresses and directions manually. I've attached the video.
[user_name], thanks so much. The video refreshed my understanding—I had forgotten to use the tool and VM mapping. Thank you again, [user_name]
One more question: Is it the same process from the newer module to the older one?

You can do it that way, but not with drag & drop. For [article_no] to [article_no], use the analog network output on the newer one and analog network input on the older one. The connection and configurations need to be set manually including addresses and directions. See the attachment.
Thank you very much. Hopefully I'll remember this, but if not, I know where to find the information!

analysis.insight_summary: Participants discuss connecting two [company_name] [product_name] modules of different versions to transfer analog input data. The initial confusion about using Parameter-VM-Mapping and compatibility between different versions ([article_no]) leads to questions. Detailed clarifications and a video guide help users understand the process. Differences in product versions require manual configuration, as drag-and-drop linking is not available.
analysis.user_expectations: The user is looking for a simple method to send analog input from one [product_name] module to another, preferably with an easy setup and accessible documentation. Guidance or a manual is requested to clarify the interconnection setup.
